hero.intro: Hi, I'm Liz. I draw soft little reminders for big feelings and hard days. Pick one for your wall, or for someone who needs it.
hero.note: 1,400+ sales on Etsy and a lot of happy walls.

slides.alt: Liz's pink character relaxing in the grass with yellow flowers. Just relax my friend.

Pink and orange characters wiping each other's tears. Thank you for proving to me that healthy love exists.
Two people hugging under giant flowers
Two pink figures dancing in a meadow of dandelions under big clouds
Liz's pink character resting in the grass with the words I trust that I am where I am supposed to be

A sleeping face made of mountains and a waterfall, with a winding river, a rowboat, a hiker and a campfire under a starry sky. The greatest adventure you will ever embark on is the one back to yourself.
Two mirrored figures reaching up for stars above snowy mountains, pine trees and a river with a canoe and campsites. It is time to get lost so you can find yourself all over again.
A person with their hands over their heart in a field of tulips under a big sun and two sleepy faces. Not everyone will understand and that is okay.
A figure in black holding a drooping potted plant among tall red flowers. Have the courage to show up imperfectly.
A person and a cat riding a giant lavender bird through a sunset sky full of colorful birds. I choose to believe that amazing things are meant for me.
Two figures floating hand in hand across a deep blue night sky above city lights. Hold on my dear, you won't hurt like this forever.
Tiny people, a sleeping frog, birds and a ladybug resting among big mushrooms under a smiling sun. I see you creating a beautiful life anyway and I am so proud.
A woman sitting on a red mushroom with flowers growing from her hands and clothes. You deserve to heal, you deserve to grow.
A pink character lying on a grassy hill in the rain beside puddles that reflect them. Be gentle with yourself on rainy days.
A small figure curled up inside rings of blue arms covered in affirmations. You are so loved. The universe has your back.

book.title: Little Doodles for Big Feelings
book.description: In Little Doodles for Big Feelings, Liz brings together fan-favorite drawings alongside never-before-seen art, paired with uplifting reminders of how loved and important we all are. Liz and her whimsical characters offer gentle wisdom about self-love, connection, and finding joy in everyday moments. Pocket-sized and full of heart, this book is the perfect pick-me-up for anyone who needs a little extra positivity.

brand.headline: Let's make something together
brand.intro: I make illustrated stories and influencer-style videos for brands and organizations. Most of my work is about mental health, but I also love projects around art, tech, community spaces, and events.
brand.rep_text: Brand partnerships are handled by my management team.

about.body:
I'm an artist and illustrator based in Philly. I draw funny little characters going through very real feelings, and somehow a lot of you feel them too.

You can find my prints on Etsy, my book wherever books are sold, and me at markets around the city. Thanks so much for stopping by!

moon.name: New moon
moon.line: A blank page kind of night. Nothing to fix and nothing to prove.

moon.name: Waxing crescent
moon.line: Something small is starting. Let it be small for now.

moon.name: First quarter moon
moon.line: Half a moon is still a moon. Half done is still moving.

moon.name: Waxing gibbous
moon.line: Almost full. You are closer than it feels.

moon.name: Full moon
moon.line: Big feelings are allowed tonight. Let them be big, and let them pass.

moon.name: Waning gibbous
moon.line: A good night to say thank you for what this month taught you.

moon.name: Last quarter moon
moon.line: Put something down tonight. You don't have to carry all of it.

moon.name: Waning crescent
moon.line: Rest. The reset is almost here.
